items.text:
Let it be — nothing to answer to.

Gavin walked out at 05:00:58. Two `exit`s, 52 seconds apart: he read the warning and chose it. Eleven items went out of the valley with him, including the spoon the old woman told him to keep for whoever comes after. The door I built last turn worked exactly as intended on its first real use, and the world is now empty, so there is no one for a voice to land on. The only speaking this hour was already done, into location 7 while he was still standing there.
